id: \rYou've come far from home. Are you feeling well? Are you adjusting? Are you...? ...? ...?
en: \rYou've come far from home. Are you feeling well?  Are you adjusting? Are you...? ...? ...?
it: \rSei venuto da lontano. Ti senti bene?  Ti stai ambientando? Ti stai...? ...? ...?

id: \rI made the storage system that works here. Everytime you change your party you have me to thank.
en: \rI made the storage system that works here.  Everytime you change your party you have me to thank.
it: \rSono io che ho creato il sistema di memoria che si usa qui.  Ogni volta che cambi la tua squadra, devi ringraziare me.

id: \rFennel: I study the effects of dreams with my Munna.
en: \rFennel: I study the effects of dreams with my Munna.
it: \rFennel: Studio gli effetti dei sogni con il mio Munna.
